description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for a Linux-based system, including image checking, copying configuration, and performing upgrades by manipulating disk partitions and images.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and layout of the disk image before upgrade, comparing partition tables to original boot disk partitions.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the target partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full upgrade process including partition comparison, flashing boot sectors, and writing image data to disk partitions.
